non_circularity: The paper fixes no step schedule for this experiment. eta_k = 1.5/(k+25)^0.75 was selected on calibration seeds 20260741 and 20260742; all reported rows use held-out seeds 2026075x and 2026076x, which were not inspected during selection.
required_checks: Run comparison-only RDNGD on dense noncommuting SPD inputs at n=5,10 and m=50
Decrease the affine-invariant Karcher objective by at least 1%
Finish within 0.5% relative objective gap of an independent fixed-point reference
Make reversed comparison signs increase the objective

source_contract.sphere_rayleigh: Section 5.1.1 eq. (13): min over the unit sphere of f(x) = -1/2 x^T A x, with B_ij ~ N(0,1/d) i.i.d., A = 1/2(B+B^T), L = lambda_max(A)-lambda_min(A) and f* = -1/2 lambda_max(A).

verdict_rule.sphere_controls: Reversing the comparison signs must leave a gap no better than the starting gap.
verdict_rule.sphere_pass: Comparison-only RDNGD at d=100 and d=150 with nu=1e-6 and 50,000 duels reaches an optimality gap below 1e-4 on every held-out seed, stays on the sphere to within 1e-12, uses no projection, and never exposes function values to the update.
